US July PPI cools, tempering rate-hike fears –
Link
US July PPI came in at 4.7% YoY, below 4.9% expected and the lowest since March, while monthly PPI was flat versus 0.2% forecast. Combined with July CPI easing from 3.5% to 3.4%, this is two straight months of moderating inflation, and market-implied odds of a September Fed rate hike fell to roughly 40%.
Matters because: Softer inflation supports risk assets like BTC/ETH, but hawkish Fed commentary keeps the signal mixed.

Dear community,

While your SafePal wallet, seed phrase, and private keys are secure; we identified a flaw in the order-tracking plug-in that led to unauthorized access to information of a subset of customers.

The issue has been fixed with additional security measures introduced.

The incident impacts approximately 39,798 customers who placed orders between March 2, 2025 and April 11, 2026. Exposed information includes name, email address, shipping address, phone number, and purchase details.

All affected customers have been notified individually by email. We have also published this webpage https://www.safepal.com/scam-protection for customers to verify if they are affected using order ID number and shipping country.

For a complete disclosure of the incident and the actions we’ve taken, along with FAQs and guidance, please refer to our blog: https://www.safepal.com/blog/security-update

Israel's Bank Leumi partners with Galaxy Digital for BTC, ETH, SOL trading –
Link
Bank Leumi, Israel's largest bank, announced a partnership with Galaxy Digital to offer retail crypto trading for BTC, ETH, and SOL via its Leumi Trade app.
• The service is targeted for an early 2027 launch.
• It adds another mainstream bank channel for crypto access.
Matters because: The partnership is another incremental bridge between traditional banking and retail crypto access, though it has no immediate market impact.

Solana advances SIMD-0553 fee overhaul proposal –
Link
A Solana proposal, SIMD-0553, that would raise fees on resource-intensive transactions while lowering costs for simple ones is progressing.
• Projected daily SOL burn: roughly 12–14x higher
• Current estimate: ≈648 SOL/day
• Proposed range: 7,500–9,000 SOL/day
Matters because: Higher structural burn could modestly tighten SOL supply growth and support long-term token economics if the proposal is adopted.

There’s always this thing that happens in the midst of change where those unable to dream or imagine the future decide to focus on the worst of any given topic or trend. It’s clear, to anyone with deep expertise and experience in capital markets, that the future of prediction markets is broad, a societal benefit, and EV positive to the collective.

Everyone is actively working to build better market structure, better information distribution, and better opportunities for businesses to manage risk. This is where the world is going. Chair Selig has been incredibly innovative in his thinking on the future of markets. The investors are all focused on helping back truth machines. Prediction Markets Are a Bad Bet

Silicon Valley’s era-defining technologies often sit on a razor’s edge between utopian and dystopian.

The sharing economy promised communal exchange at the tap of a smart phone — or risking it all by jumping in a stranger’s car, or trusting others to deliver. (It largely ended up being more banal: convenient, smartphone-enhanced regulatory arbitrage.)

AI is giving everyone a genius at their fingertips — or creating a super-intelligence that will put us out of jobs and maybe destroy the world.

tweet.text:
Completely false.

I like Gavin's takes, but whoever he heard this from is lying so that it fits the narrative some people so desperately want you to believe. 

The same people will try to convince you Anthropic has no moat, and a sentence later that it might become so powerful it could be the only company left.

In fact, one of the things we are _most_ worried about is economic concentration of power. There is no world where the government should let any company have that much influence. We need competition and capitalism. https://darioamodei.com/essay/the-adolescence-of-technology#2-a-surprising-and-terrible-empowerment

The AI market is literally the most competetive market in the world right now - every single one of the largest companies on earth is singularly focused on getting you smarter, cheaper models. If it all works out, we'll succeed in reducing the cost of everything to the cost of energy. This is awesome, but it threatens a lot of people's old moats. They are frightened.
